description: This Java source file defines the class ConfigurationModulesLoader, which provides utility methods for serializing and deserializing integration configuration data to and from JSON format. It handles loading configurations from JSON strings into objects and converting configuration objects into JSON strings.

classes.name: ConfigurationModulesLoader
classes.description: A utility class for loading and converting integration configuration data between Java objects and JSON strings.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts a Map of IntegrationConfiguration objects into a JSON string array representation.

methods.name: loadIntegrationConfigurations
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to load and instantiate a Map of IntegrationConfiguration objects, handling data binding and validation.
